name: Hinkelsteinwiese
beschreibung: The Hinkelsteinwiese is an idyllic natural tent and group campsite managed by the Tyrolean Scout Centre Igls (TPZ) at Heiligwasserwiese 5 in Innsbruck-Igls. Nestled into the forested slopes at the base of the Patscherkofel high above Tyrol's capital city, this green expanse provides an ideal setting for youth groups, clubs, outdoor camps, and nature enthusiasts. Practical amenities include outdoor sanitary facilities with hot showers and washbasins, designated camp fire pits, barbecue barrels, and rental options for benches, tables, and pioneering wood. From the meadow, diverse hiking trails lead to the pilgrimage site of Heiligwasser and up Mount Patscherkofel. Innsbruck's historic old town is easily reached via the scenic forest tram line 6 or local bus.
kurzbeschreibung: Idyllic natural campsite of the Scout Centre in Innsbruck-Igls at Heiligwasserwiese at the base of the Patscherkofel.
